Codes.Name: AllStagesUnlocked
Codes.Author: dreamsyntax
Codes.Description: All stages unlocked on stage select.

Codes.Name: UseOfficialTitleOnTitleBar
Codes.Author: Sora
Codes.Description: Displays "SHADOW THE HEDGEHOG" on the title bar.

Codes.Name: EasyLastStoryUnlock
Codes.Author: Sora
Codes.InternalName: Easier Way to Unlock Last Story
Codes.Description: Only 5 endings will be needed to unlock Last Story.

Codes.Name: InfiniteAmmo
Codes.Author: Sora
Codes.Description: Weapons never run out of ammo.

Codes.Name: FillChaosControlGaugeOnInput
Codes.Author: Sora
Codes.InternalName: Press Z+R To Fill Hero Meter
Codes.Description: Press Z+R to fills the Hero gauge (Chaos Control).

Codes.Name: FillChaosBlastGaugeOnInput
Codes.Author: Sora
Codes.InternalName: Press Z+L To Fill Dark Meter
Codes.Description: Press Z+L to fills the Dark gauge (Chaos Blast).

Codes.Name: VacuumAnyEnemy
Codes.Author: Sora
Codes.Description: Vacuum Pod and Vacuum Egg can suck in enemies that are normally immune.

Codes.Name: VacuumGivePointsOnFireSuck
Codes.Author: dreamsyntax
Codes.Description: Sucking up fire with the Vacuum gives score and Hero points.

Codes.Name: HoldLTForceJumpDash
Codes.Author: dreamsyntax
Codes.InternalName: Hold L To Force Jump Dash
Codes.Description: Hold L while doing a Homing Attack to do a Jump Dash instead.

Codes.Name: XboxEarlyTargetBehavior
Codes.Author: dreamsyntax
Codes.Description: Restores the Xbox build behavior where hidden enemies can be targeted (Black Worms out of bounds, Black Ninjas while warping).

Codes.Name: PlayAsBattleCharacters
Codes.Author: dreamsyntax
Codes.Description: Story mode uses the character picked for Player 1 in Battle Mode. Skipped on the Devil Doom fight.

Codes.Name: ShadowAndroidsNoEmbeddedWeapons
Codes.Author: dreamsyntax
Codes.Description: Some Shadow Androids have embedded weapons and cannot pick weapons in-game. This code disables the built in weapon, so other weapons can be used normally.

Codes.Name: SelectModeExpertStages
Codes.Author: dreamsyntax
Codes.Description: Use 'X' instead of 'A' in Select Mode to play a stage's Expert Mode variant.

Codes.Name: SelectModeEnableLastStoryDevilDoomSlots
Codes.Author: dreamsyntax
Codes.InternalName: Show Last Way and Devil Doom in Stage Select
Codes.Description: Puts Last Way below Final Haunt and Devil Doom to the right of that. There is no visual for it, but you'll hear the selection of the stage as normal.

Codes.Name: SkipLoadingAnyEvents
Codes.Author: dreamsyntax
Codes.Description: Events will be skipped entirely, bypassing any extra loading screens.

Codes.Name: SingleFrameInvulnRecovery
Codes.Author: dreamsyntax
Codes.Description: Sort of a "hard mode", makes invulnerability only last for 1 frame, but you also recover faster.

Codes.Name: AllPartnersCanHomingAttack
Codes.Author: dreamsyntax
Codes.Description: Originally only Sonic can Homing Attack. Now everyone else can too!
